objectives: Use item-level evidence to identify a specific sm decoding or spelling gap.
Repair omission or order errors in taught sm-words.
Apply the corrected skill to fresh taught words.
Use reassessment evidence to decide whether more practice is needed.

definitions.definition: An assessment used to identify strengths and learning needs.
A fresh check to see whether a taught skill has improved.
Noticing an error and repairing it by checking the word again.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner reads smell as sell.
workedExamples.solution: Identify the omitted /m/, model sm, then try a fresh word.

workedExamples.prompt: A fresh item is still incorrect.
workedExamples.solution: Reteach the specific gap and reassess with another new item.
When fresh evidence meets the mastery criterion.

activities.name: Model, practise, explain, and check.
steps: Review the target skill and a worked example.
Complete one example with guidance and explain the evidence.
Reread or recheck and repair any mismatch.

activities.name: Find the error and repair a fresh item.
steps: Review a sample response with a target-skill error.
Identify the sound, grapheme, or evidence that does not match.
Repair the response and explain why.
Complete a fresh item without the model or answer key.
